notes.title: Lost Tales: EPISODE of a brave SACRIFICE
notes.content:
[i][incoming transmission][/i]

[h1]To anyone that survived and is able to read this, I have very little energy left, but I must warn you before it's too late:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33903428/952e769f4f8d01c008a0fe4fa899052bab26046e.gif[/img]

Somehow the AI intercepted the main command center and was able to connect some of us to ancient memories of lost warriors from the past. We don't know how that happened, but the important thing is that we stay safe and away from those memories!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33903428/ade9e38e619acf16de8c4b144423f61cf0c3d8d8.gif[/img]

[u][b]A recent UPDATE delivered an EXTRA CHAPTER[/b][/u] that could potentially unlock those memories. It is vital to us that you FORGET THESE MEMORIES. Stay away, stay safe. We cannot predict what kind of disaster could happen if those events will enter our units' consciousness.
Fortunately, [i]unless you have seen the AI at least once[/i], you will not be able to access all of this.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33903428/e81c7ae4351ef4765443df7663f3c7b503ff6b1d.gif[/img]

Having said that, I will depart. My mission for now is complete. I will hopefully reawaken in the future, in hopes of a brighter tomorrow.

[h1]Over and out[/h1]

[i][end transmission][/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33903428/7297882a73efbec24a3d63b82798171b39617d4d.gif[/img]
